name: 额度与成本
description: 会话级多模型账本：按 API 提供商和模型连续累计成本、显示 token 与有效单价；订阅调用明确不计费。
descriptionEn: Conversation-level multi-model ledger: continuous cost totals by API provider and model, with token and effective-rate details; subscription calls are explicitly excluded.

name: 代理健康
description: 探测可配置的 HTTPS 目标及代理链路；无代理时检测直连，失败时对比第二目标，谨慎提示网络问题。
descriptionEn: Probe a configurable HTTPS target via an HTTP(S) proxy or directly; compare a second site on failure without assuming the root cause.

name: 重连
description: 断连恢复：查看网页服务与重启守护状态，一键重新连接或重启网页服务（配套可选独立守护进程，服务卡死也能救回来）。
descriptionEn: Reconnection & service recovery: inspect web service and companion watchdog health, reconnect or restart services in one click (optional standalone watchdog survives a hung service).
